AccountExport.description: A data export: a zip laid out like a local library, plus `account.json`.

AdminSession.description: A session of the user, without its token.

expiresAt.description: When it ends, unless it is seen again.

AdminSupportContext.description: What the app attached to a request.

screen.description: The route template of the screen the person was on.

AdminSupportMessage.description: A message of a request, internal notes included.

adminId.description: The admin who wrote it; `null` for the person's messages.

internal.description: Whether it is a note of the team the person never sees.

AdminSupportRequest.description: A request as the team sees it, without its messages.

ageSeconds.description: How long ago it was sent, in seconds.

assignedTo.description: The admin it is assigned to; `null` for nobody.

firstResponseAt.description: When the team first replied; `null` before.

hasScreenshot.description: Whether a screenshot came with it.

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved or closed, while it is.

updatedAt.description: When its status last changed, or its author or the team last wrote.

AdminSupportThread.description: A request with its context and every message, oldest first, internal notes included.

hasScreenshot.description: Whether a screenshot came with it, served by `GET /support-requests/{id}/screenshot`.

messages.description: Its messages: the first is the request's own.

AdminUser.description: A user as the search lists them.

lastSeenAt.description: When one of its sessions was last seen; `null` without a session.

AdminUserDetail.description:

events of the last 30 days by name, the sessions and the support requests.

events.description: Its product events of the last 30 days, by name.

language.description: The language of its interface and emails.

lastSeenAt.description: When one of its sessions was last seen; `null` without a session.

sessions.description: Its sessions, the most recently seen first.

supportRequests.description: Its support requests, the most recently updated first.

AdminUserStatus.description: Whether an account may sign in.

startsAt.description: When it started firing, in RFC 3339.

Alerts.description: The firing alerts of an environment, newest first.

AuditEntryBody.description: An entry of the audit log: who did what, to what, when, why, and the state before and after.

id.description: Its id: later entries have larger ones.

reason.description: Why, for the actions on an account.

ConsoleSession.description:
A live session: who is signed in, the token every unsafe request sends in `X-CSRF-Token`,
the environment this console administers and those its monitoring shows.

monitoredEnvironments.description: `LPA_ENVIRONMENTS`: the environments the monitoring routes take as `env`.

DayCountBody.description: A count of one day, week or month, named by its first day.

day.description: Its first day, at midnight UTC.

EventCountBody.description: How many product events of one name.

ExportCountBody.description: How many exports of one format from one source.

url.description: Grafana Explore, split between the request's logs and its trace.

status.description: Always `ok`: an admin server that cannot answer sends a problem.

HealthStatus.description: The status of a healthy admin server.

LogLevel.description: A log level the console filters by.

level.description: Its level, when it has one.

requestId.description: The request it belongs to, when it names one.

MessagePost.description: A message of the team: a reply the person is emailed about, or an internal note.

body.description: Its text: 1 to 5,000 characters once trimmed.

internal.description: Whether it is a note the person never sees, rather than a reply.

from.description: The range's start, in Unix seconds.

to.description: The range's end, in Unix seconds.

Page_AdminSupportRequest.description: A page of a list, from the most recently updated item.

items.description: A request as the team sees it, without its messages.

ageSeconds.description: How long ago it was sent, in seconds.

assignedTo.description: The admin it is assigned to; `null` for nobody.

firstResponseAt.description: When the team first replied; `null` before.

hasScreenshot.description: Whether a screenshot came with it.

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved or closed, while it is.

updatedAt.description: When its status last changed, or its author or the team last wrote.

nextCursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; `null` on the last one.

Page_AdminUser.description: A page of a list, from the most recently updated item.

items.description: A user as the search lists them.

lastSeenAt.description: When one of its sessions was last seen; `null` without a session.

nextCursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; `null` on the last one.

Page_AuditEntryBody.description: A page of a list, from the most recently updated item.

items.description: An entry of the audit log: who did what, to what, when, why, and the state before and after.

id.description: Its id: later entries have larger ones.

reason.description: Why, for the actions on an account.

nextCursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; `null` on the last one.

Panel.description: A panel of the monitoring views.

PanelSeries.description: A panel's series over the range, and the previous period's, moved onto the range.

from.description: The range's start, in Unix seconds.

previous.description: The previous period's series, their times moved forward by the range's length.

to.description: The range's end, in Unix seconds.

Problem.description:
An error, as RFC 9457 problem details with a stable code and its parameters, never a
sentence: the interface translates `errors.<code>`.

code.description: The stable code, dot-separated `snake_case` segments, domain first.

params.description: The parameters of the code's message, with camelCase keys.

activatedAccounts.description: The accounts whose first export falls in the period.

activePerDay.description: The active accounts of each day.

activePerMonth.description: The active accounts of each month.

activePerWeek.description: The active accounts of each week.

exports.description: The exports by format and source.

mcpCalls.description: The MCP calls by tool and outcome.

storage.description: The accounts by class of storage used, now.

ProductMetricsBody.description: The product metrics of a period.

ReasonBody.description: Why an admin acts on an account: kept in the audit log.

reason.description: The reason: 1 to 1,000 characters once trimmed.

RequestPatch.description: A change of a request: its status, its assignee, or both.

assignedTo.description: The admin id it is assigned to; `null` for nobody. Absent, the assignee stays.

Screenshot.description: A request's screenshot, as the PNG it was stored as.

Series.description: One series of a panel, as uPlot draws it: its times and values side by side.

labels.description: The series' labels, such as `route` or `format`.

name.description: The query's name: the panel's, or `p50`, `p95`, `p99`.

values.description: The value at each time; `null` where there is none.

code.description: The current code of the admin's authenticator: six digits.

SizeClassCountBody.description: How many accounts in one class of storage used.

StatusCountBody.description: How many open requests of one status.

SupportCategory.description: What a support request is about.

medianAgeSeconds.description: The median age of the open requests now, in seconds; `null` without one.

medianFirstResponseSeconds.description:
The median time to a first answer of the requests first answered over the period, in
seconds; `null` without one.

medianResolutionSeconds.description:
The median time to resolution of the requests resolved over the period, in seconds;
`null` without one.

openByStatus.description: The open requests by status, now.

SupportRequestSummary.description: A request of the account, without its messages.

hasScreenshot.description: Whether a screenshot came with it; the screenshot itself is never served back.

Tile.description:
One tile of the overview: a panel's value at the end of the range, and at the end of the
previous one; `null` when there is no data.

value.description: Its value: the sum of its series; `latency` is p95.

ToolCountBody.description: How many MCP calls of one tool with one outcome.

info.description: The admin server's API, which only the admin console calls: signing in with a password and a TOTP code, monitoring, and the server's internal admin API relayed on behalf of the signed-in admin. A session is the `__Host-lpa_session` cookie; a change also sends `X-CSRF-Token`.
